tools.name: list_worktrees
tools.description: List Git worktrees in this project with registered IDs. Entries without an ID must be registered before delegation. Use git_status with a registered worktree ID to inspect changes. This conversation's file tools work only in its own worktree; do not cd into another worktree to change it.

tools.name: create_worktree
tools.description: Create and register an isolated worktree and new branch in the execution Node's managed directory, starting from this turn's worktree. Use head and index_revision from git_status as expected_head and expected_index. include_changes defaults to false; set true to copy uncommitted changes. Use the returned ID with spawn_agent.worktree. This does not move this conversation or merge changes. To develop there, pass the returned ID to spawn_agent. If the user wants this conversation itself to continue there, ask them to switch it with the composer's worktree selector, then stop. Never cd into the new worktree or change it from this conversation. After a delegated child finishes, remove its worktree when it has no changes and no new commits; otherwise follow remove_worktree. Invoke directly under the current permission mode; do not request approval through ask_user.

tools.name: register_worktree
tools.description: Register an existing Git worktree from this project's repository. Use its absolute path from list_worktrees; the returned ID can be passed to spawn_agent. No checkout or session is moved.

tools.name: remove_worktree
tools.description: Remove a clean linked worktree, keeping its branch. Use head and branch from git_status or list_worktrees as expected_head and expected_branch. Main, dirty, locked or busy worktrees, including ones with running or queued turns, cannot be removed. Sessions that used it keep their history but cannot run new turns there. When a delegated child's worktree has changes or new commits, inspect them with Git tools and its worktree ID first. Integrate with an unrestricted git merge or cherry-pick command only when appropriate; stop and report conflicts to the user without resolving them automatically. Uncommitted changes block removal; never discard work or session history to make removal succeed. Invoke directly under the current permission mode; do not request approval through ask_user.
